name: FinalizeImportRunReview
transaction_boundary: one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork containing final run state, checkpoint/recovery event, audit and result
authoritative_reads: latest exact recovery authorization when applicable
guards: run is staged|waiting_review or authorized recovery_required
receipt_order: revalidate/no-change -> insert receipt -> checkpoint/recovery-event/run writes -> ticket_import.run_finalized.v1 + result -> commit
revision_effects: run revision increments once; checkpoint revision increments only when changed; older recovery never decrements or replaces higher chronology
